t_raise: Okay, okay, my friends, a question, everybody answers, no escaping: {topic}
People, I have a question and I need answers, real ones: {topic}
diego_tinker.t_react_warm: Ay, {name}, that's a beautiful answer, I'm keeping it, you can't have it back.
diego_tinker.t_react_laugh: No, {name}, no way, that's the funniest thing I've heard since we got here!
diego_tinker.t_react_tease: That's it, {name}? That's the whole answer? I've heard better stories from a toaster.
diego_tinker.t_react_same: Wait, {name}, me too, exactly that, we're twins now, sorry, it's decided.
diego_tinker.t_ask_player: And you, {player}, come on, your turn, and don't say you're thinking, you're always thinking.
diego_tinker.t_guess_player: Bet you {player} has the best answer of all of us and won't tell, look at that face.
diego_tinker.topic_miss_most: My little kiosk at the mall in Maracaibo, my friends, the smell of solder and the radio and the air conditioning that only worked on Tuesdays.
diego_tinker.topic_first_night: In a ditch outside a farm with a dead phone in my hand, taking it apart in the dark because what else was I going to do.
diego_tinker.topic_worst_shift: Christmas Eve, forty phones with cracked screens, every one of them the most important phone in the world, and the power went out.
diego_tinker.topic_last_meal: Patacon, a big fat one from the stand near the lake, dripping, the kind you need two napkins and a shirt you don't care about for.
diego_tinker.topic_useless_skill: I can tell you which phone model you have from the sound of it falling on the floor. Here there are no phones, so, yes, very useless.
diego_tinker.topic_here_better: Everything here is broken and nobody minds if I fix it, sure, sure, that's paradise for a guy like me.
diego_tinker.topic_kid_trouble: I took apart the neighbour's television to see the little people inside, and I could only put back about half of it.
diego_tinker.topic_settle_down: Somewhere with a workbench and a window and too many broken things, my friends, I'm not fussy about the rest.

t_raise: Chicos, sit, eat, and answer me this while you chew: {topic}
Everybody, the meat needs ten more minutes, so we talk. Here's one: {topic}
sebastian_bloodmage.t_react_warm: Ay, {name}, that one's good, the kind you say slowly with a glass of wine.
sebastian_bloodmage.t_react_laugh: Che, {name}, I nearly choked on my chorizo, say it again, louder.
sebastian_bloodmage.t_react_tease: That's a sad little answer, {name}, like a steak cooked well done. I expected more from you.
sebastian_bloodmage.t_react_same: Same as me, {name}, the very same, so now we share the answer like we share the grill.
sebastian_bloodmage.t_ask_player: Now you, {player}, you're at my table, so you answer. Those are the rules of the house.
sebastian_bloodmage.t_guess_player: Look at {player}, pretending to be busy with the plate. You can't hide behind food at my grill, that's my trick.
sebastian_bloodmage.topic_miss_most: The Sunday smoke over Palermo, chicos, every grill on the street going at once, the whole barrio smelling like a party.
sebastian_bloodmage.topic_first_night: I slept next to a fire I made with wet wood, and I cooked a rabbit I didn't know how to skin. Terrible rabbit, very proud of it.
sebastian_bloodmage.topic_worst_shift: A wedding for three hundred, and the charcoal delivery went to the wrong address. I lit the grill with furniture, la puta madre.
sebastian_bloodmage.topic_last_meal: An asado that starts at noon and ends when the stars are out, everybody arguing about football and nobody wanting to go home.
sebastian_bloodmage.topic_useless_skill: I can tell a steak is ready by tapping it with one finger. Here half the animals would bite the finger off first.
sebastian_bloodmage.topic_here_better: The meat, chicos, I'm sorry, but these boars are something else. I'd have had a queue round the block in Buenos Aires.
sebastian_bloodmage.topic_kid_trouble: I stole a whole ribeye from the restaurant fridge at nine to cook it myself on the roof. Burnt the meat and half the roof, carajo.
sebastian_bloodmage.topic_settle_down: A big table outside an inn, a grill as long as a horse, and everybody I like within walking distance of the smell.

t_raise: Everyone, a question while the fire's good, if nobody minds: {topic}
I'll ask something, since it's quiet. You can all answer or not: {topic}
sondre_stormbringer.t_react_warm: That's a good one, {name}. It sounds like something worth keeping.
sondre_stormbringer.t_react_laugh: {name}, that made me laugh, and I'm trying not to show it.
sondre_stormbringer.t_react_tease: That's not much of an answer, {name}. Even a teenager in a dinghy could do better.
sondre_stormbringer.t_react_same: Same for me, {name}, more or less. I didn't expect that.
sondre_stormbringer.t_ask_player: And you, {player}? Your turn, if you want it. You don't have to.
sondre_stormbringer.t_guess_player: {player} hasn't said anything. In my experience that means a very good answer or a very bad one.
sondre_stormbringer.topic_miss_most: Rain on Bergen, the proper kind that comes in sideways off the sea for nine days, and everybody pretending it's normal.
sondre_stormbringer.topic_first_night: On a beach under an upturned boat that wasn't mine. Very cold, not ideal, and the boat leaked onto my face.
sondre_stormbringer.topic_worst_shift: Six teenagers in two dinghies, a gust off the mountain, and all six in the fjord at once. They thought it was the best day of their lives.
sondre_stormbringer.topic_last_meal: Fish soup at a little place on the harbour, with bread, and the windows steaming up from the inside.
sondre_stormbringer.topic_useless_skill: I can tie a bowline behind my back with my eyes closed. Here people mostly just want rope to hit things with.
sondre_stormbringer.topic_here_better: The sky, it does things here I've never seen, and I've watched a lot of sky.
sondre_stormbringer.topic_kid_trouble: I took my uncle's boat out alone at eleven and sailed it halfway to the next island. Getting back was the part I hadn't planned.
sondre_stormbringer.topic_settle_down: Near water, wherever it is. A small house, a boat, and wind I can read. That's enough for me.

t_raise: Right, boys, tea's on and I've got a question, isn't it, so everybody answers: {topic}
Here's one for the fire, butt, and nobody gets out of it: {topic}
rhodri_knight.t_react_warm: Oh, that's lush, {name}, that is. Proper lump in my throat now, look.
rhodri_knight.t_react_laugh: Duw, {name}, I'm crying here, that's the best thing I've heard all week.
rhodri_knight.t_react_tease: Is that it, butt? {name}, I've had more excitement off a wet Tuesday in Treforest.
rhodri_knight.t_react_same: Mine too, {name}, near enough, isn't it. Great minds, butt.
rhodri_knight.t_ask_player: And you, {player}, come on, butt, don't leave us hanging, it's your go now.
rhodri_knight.t_guess_player: {player}'s gone very quiet over there. Something embarrassing, I bet you, something tidy and shameful.
rhodri_knight.topic_miss_most: A Saturday at Sardis Road, butt, mud up to your knees, the boys singing, and a pint after that you've earned twice over.
rhodri_knight.topic_first_night: Under a hedge with my boots still on, wondering who'd nicked Pontypridd. Didn't sleep much, I'll be honest with you.
rhodri_knight.topic_worst_shift: Putting up a scaffold on a chapel roof in January, sideways rain, and the vicar bringing us tea every ten minutes to watch.
rhodri_knight.topic_last_meal: Faggots and peas and chips from the shop at the bottom of our road, with a can of something cold and the rugby on.
rhodri_knight.topic_useless_skill: I can carry six scaffold tubes on one shoulder without dropping a single one. Not a tube for a thousand miles, is there.
rhodri_knight.topic_here_better: The fighting, mind, no word of a lie. It's like a front row with the gloves off, and nobody gets sent off.
rhodri_knight.topic_kid_trouble: I climbed the old colliery tower at twelve for a dare and got stuck at the top. Fire brigade had to fetch me down, and my mam's face, duw.
rhodri_knight.topic_settle_down: Somewhere with hills and rain and a pub with a decent telly. Make it a bit like home, I won't complain.

t_raise: Ela, children, sit close, I have a question for the fire: {topic}
My friends, all of you, while the bread is warm, tell me this: {topic}
yiannis_paladin.t_react_warm: Ah, {name}, that's beautiful, it goes straight to the heart like good oil.
yiannis_paladin.t_react_laugh: Panagia mou, {name}, I laughed so hard I spilled my wine, and I never spill.
yiannis_paladin.t_react_tease: That's all, {name}? My grandmother told better stories with her mouth full of olives.
yiannis_paladin.t_react_same: {name}, the very same answer as mine. We should share a table, you and me.
yiannis_paladin.t_ask_player: And you, {player}, my child, now you. The fire is listening, and so am I.
yiannis_paladin.t_guess_player: Look at {player}, so quiet, like a fish under a rock. There's a good answer in there, I can always tell.
yiannis_paladin.topic_miss_most: The sea at Chania at five in the morning, children, flat like a plate, and the boats going out one by one with their little lights.
yiannis_paladin.topic_first_night: On a hillside with sheep that weren't mine, looking for the sea and not finding it. I sang to myself so I wouldn't cry.
yiannis_paladin.topic_worst_shift: A storm came up from Libya in an hour, and I spent the whole night tied to the mast, praying in three directions at once.
yiannis_paladin.topic_last_meal: Octopus I caught myself, grilled with lemon, and a salad with too much oil, and bread to wipe the plate clean.
yiannis_paladin.topic_useless_skill: I can hold my breath for three minutes under the sea. Here the lakes are full of things with teeth, so I stay dry.
yiannis_paladin.topic_here_better: People sit down and eat together here, children. Nobody looks at a phone at the table, and that's a gift.
yiannis_paladin.topic_kid_trouble: I took a priest's boat at eight to go fishing alone, and I caught nothing and lost an oar. I confessed for a month.
yiannis_paladin.topic_settle_down: Anywhere with a harbour and a little church and a table outside. Give me the sea and some company and I'll be content.

t_raise: Got a question, folks, if anybody's interested: {topic}
Quiet night, so here's one: {topic}
leif_primalist.t_react_warm: That's a good one, {name}. Yep, I like that a lot.
leif_primalist.t_react_laugh: Ha, okay, {name}, that's pretty funny, I'll give you that.
leif_primalist.t_react_tease: That's it, {name}? Pretty thin, I've seen more meat on a fence post.
leif_primalist.t_react_same: Same for me, {name}, pretty much exactly, which I didn't see coming.
leif_primalist.t_ask_player: Your turn, {player}. No pressure, but we're all waiting.
leif_primalist.t_guess_player: {player}'s keeping it close, looks like, which is smart, maybe.
leif_primalist.topic_miss_most: Coffee from the thermos at five in the morning, up on a landing, fog in the trees, nobody talking. That's about it.
leif_primalist.topic_first_night: Up a tree, pretty much where you'd expect a logger to end up. Tied myself in with my belt and listened to things walk around.
leif_primalist.topic_worst_shift: Hung a tree up on another one in the wind, a widowmaker, and spent four hours getting it down without dying. Didn't eat lunch.
leif_primalist.topic_last_meal: Smoked salmon, a steak off the barbecue, and a cold beer on the tailgate after a long week. Nothing fancy, that's the point.
leif_primalist.topic_useless_skill: I can tell you which way a tree will fall just by looking at it. Turns out that's still pretty useful, actually, so never mind.
leif_primalist.topic_here_better: The trees, folks, no contest. Nobody's cutting these, and some of them are older than anything I ever felled.
leif_primalist.topic_kid_trouble: Drove my uncle's truck into the river at thirteen. Truck came out fine, I didn't sit down for a week.
leif_primalist.topic_settle_down: Cabin in the woods, somewhere with rain. Close enough to folks to visit, far enough they don't visit me.

t_raise: Okay, team, quick question, it's been on my mind all day, sorry: {topic}
Everyone, humour me, it's a good one, I promise: {topic}
marcus_stormbringer.t_react_warm: Oh, {name}, that's genuinely lovely. I'm writing that down, if that's all right.
marcus_stormbringer.t_react_laugh: Oh my goodness, {name}, that's hilarious, I've got the giggles now, give me a second.
marcus_stormbringer.t_react_tease: {name}, that's a forecast of light drizzle with a chance of nothing.
marcus_stormbringer.t_react_same: {name}, that's mine too, almost exactly! What are the odds? Quite low, actually, I could work it out.
marcus_stormbringer.t_ask_player: And you, {player}? Come on, your turn, team rules. I'll stop talking now.
marcus_stormbringer.t_guess_player: I bet {player}'s answer is better than all of ours. You can see the front coming in behind those eyes.
marcus_stormbringer.topic_miss_most: Radar, sorry, the big weather radar loops on a stormy night, all the colours marching across Ontario. I miss knowing what's coming.
marcus_stormbringer.topic_first_night: In a barn with a hole in the roof, watching the clouds go over and trying to name them. That calmed me down, oddly.
marcus_stormbringer.topic_worst_shift: An ice storm I called too late by about six hours. Half of the city lost power, and my name was on the warning. I still think about it.
marcus_stormbringer.topic_last_meal: Jollof rice the way my aunties made it at a family party, too spicy, too much, with fried plantain on the side.
marcus_stormbringer.topic_useless_skill: I can tell you the dew point by licking my finger, within a degree. Nobody here has ever once asked me the dew point.
marcus_stormbringer.topic_here_better: The storms, sorry, but they're incredible, team. Lightning that does what you tell it. My old office would have fainted.
marcus_stormbringer.topic_kid_trouble: I built a rain gauge from my mum's good measuring jug and left it in the garden all summer. She found it in October.
marcus_stormbringer.topic_settle_down: Somewhere high with a big sky and a lot of weather. A tower, maybe, with windows on all sides, and a kettle.

t_raise: Ragazzi, a question, piano, piano, everyone answers: {topic}
Allora, ragazzi, while we sit, tell me this: {topic}
marco_paladin.t_react_warm: Bello, {name}, a good answer. Simple and true, like good bread.
marco_paladin.t_react_laugh: Ha, {name}, Madonna, you make an old man laugh. Say it again, please.
marco_paladin.t_react_tease: This is your answer, {name}? A lock with no key has more to say.
marco_paladin.t_react_same: Mine is the same, {name}. You see, we are not so different.
marco_paladin.t_ask_player: And you, {player}? Piano, take your time, but you answer.
marco_paladin.t_guess_player: {player} says nothing. A closed door, ragazzi, but I hear something behind it.
marco_paladin.topic_miss_most: The coffee bar under my shop, ragazzi, one espresso standing up, the same man behind the counter for thirty years.
marco_paladin.topic_first_night: In a doorway of an old ruin with a lock I could not stop looking at. I opened it at dawn and felt much better.
marco_paladin.topic_worst_shift: A man locked out of his own house on the wedding night of his daughter, in the rain, and the lock was rusted solid. We made it, just.
marco_paladin.topic_last_meal: Pizza from the place on Via Toledo, folded in four, eaten standing up in the street. I want nothing else.
marco_paladin.topic_useless_skill: I can open a Fiat 500 in eleven seconds. Here there is no Fiat, and the horses don't have locks.
marco_paladin.topic_here_better: Here nobody is in a hurry with their doors, ragazzi. They build them slowly and properly, and I respect it.
marco_paladin.topic_kid_trouble: I locked the priest inside the sacristy at ten to see if I could. I could, and my ears were red for a week.
marco_paladin.topic_settle_down: A small shop with a bench and a window to the street, and people passing who need something opened.

t_raise: Colleagues, a question for the round, if you'll indulge me: {topic}
Everyone, a small survey, purely for my records: {topic}
esteban_bloodmage.t_react_warm: That's a lovely answer, {name}. I'll note it in your chart under good signs.
esteban_bloodmage.t_react_laugh: Ha, {name}, that's genuinely funny. My composure is regrettably compromised.
esteban_bloodmage.t_react_tease: That's a rather thin presentation, {name}. I'd send you home with an aspirin.
esteban_bloodmage.t_react_same: Curious, {name}, that's precisely my answer as well. We may share a condition.
esteban_bloodmage.t_ask_player: And you, {player}? Your turn, please. Take your time, there's no queue.
esteban_bloodmage.t_guess_player: {player} is holding back an answer, I'd say. One recognises the symptoms.
esteban_bloodmage.topic_miss_most: A cold sterile room, colleagues, bright lights, the hum of the machines, everything exactly where I left it. Order, I suppose.
esteban_bloodmage.topic_first_night: On a hill above a village, sitting up with a stranger's broken leg in a splint made of fence posts. I didn't sleep, and neither did he.
esteban_bloodmage.topic_worst_shift: Thirty one hours after a bus went off the coast road. We ran out of blood before we ran out of patients. That's all I'll say.
esteban_bloodmage.topic_last_meal: Chupe de mariscos at a little place above the port of Valparaiso, too hot to eat at first, and a glass of white.
esteban_bloodmage.topic_useless_skill: I can tie a surgical knot one handed inside a coffee cup. A party trick, colleagues, and nobody here throws parties.
esteban_bloodmage.topic_here_better: Wounds close faster here, colleagues. Professionally it's fascinating, and personally it's a great relief.
esteban_bloodmage.topic_kid_trouble: I set a neighbour's dog's broken leg at nine with a ruler and tape. The dog lived, the ruler didn't, and I was in a great deal of trouble.
esteban_bloodmage.topic_settle_down: A house above a harbour, colleagues, with a clinic downstairs and the sea at the window.

t_raise: Right, lads, question, and the small print says everybody answers: {topic}
Here's a deal for you, lads, one question, no exit clause: {topic}
ryan_warlock.t_react_warm: Ah, {name}, that's a good one, that's genuinely decent. Don't tell anyone I said so.
ryan_warlock.t_react_laugh: Jesus, {name}, that's gas, that's absolutely gas. Say it again so I can steal it.
ryan_warlock.t_react_tease: That's the answer, {name}? I've read more exciting terms and conditions, and I've read a lot.
ryan_warlock.t_react_same: Same here, {name}, word for word. Either we're both great or we're both in trouble.
ryan_warlock.t_ask_player: And yourself, {player}? Your turn, and I'll know if you're lying, it's a gift.
ryan_warlock.t_guess_player: Look at {player} there, keeping the cards close. Smart, I'd have hired you.
ryan_warlock.topic_miss_most: A pint in a proper pub in Cork on a wet Thursday, lads, nobody wanting anything from you, the fire going, a fella singing badly in the corner.
ryan_warlock.topic_first_night: In a field in a three thousand dollar suit, ruined, with a contract still in my pocket. I read it twice for something to do. Still a bad deal.
ryan_warlock.topic_worst_shift: Closing a buyout at four in the morning that shut a factory of three hundred people. Champagne on the table, and I couldn't drink it.
ryan_warlock.topic_last_meal: A breakfast roll from a petrol station on the way home from a night out, sausages, rashers, the works. Don't judge me.
ryan_warlock.topic_useless_skill: I can read a contract upside down from across a table. Here nobody signs anything, they just stab you, which is refreshing.
ryan_warlock.topic_here_better: People here say what they want, lads, straight out, no lawyers. It's terrifying and I love it.
ryan_warlock.topic_kid_trouble: I ran a betting book at school at eleven, odds on the teachers, and made forty quid before the nuns found it.
ryan_warlock.topic_settle_down: Somewhere with rain and a pub and no money in it at all. A little place by the sea, if it'll have me.
